title: Explicit ambient neighborhoods and source/square boundary words
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and two EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram data for f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, choose a side n. Form the literal proper ambient products and selected open neighborhoods F,G,H of the product presentations. Construct N=H.P×_{P_n}V_n, its inclusion K, the induced open E:H.U→N, and proper maps R:N→G.U, BV:F.P→N, BW:F.U→H.U. The projection equations give the B and Q commutative squares and zF BW=zH. Define ambientLambda, shrinkLambda and the fixed inverse-B and Q interchange words as before. Define rawSquare by the supplied k-square exchange with open/proper compositors, without the identity graph normalization. Define sourceTransport from the selected source word to (RzH JE RR) RqG by splitting a=zH qH, exchanging the e-side square, and refactoring qN r=R qG. Define middleTail from RqG Ji Rq to J(G.e) R(G.p) by the Cartesian g-side exchange and final proper compositor. All constructions are the explicit words in the module; no isomorphism between bare endpoints is chosen. The inputs and fixed exchange words are those of [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data] and [def-pur-etale-graph-product-interchange]; the product presentations and normalizations are [lem-pur-etale-graph-product-geometry] and [lem-pur-etale-pairwise-product-graph-normalization]. Pullbacks are [def-pc-fibre-product]; the proper-to-separated-target criterion used for the explicit maps is [lemma-nagata-proper-to-separated-target].

def rawSquare (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (d : EtaleGraphInterchangeDiagram f g) :
    d.sourcePresentation.functor A ⋙
        (D((d.i)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ⋙ R((d.q)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])) ≅
      d.compositePresentation.functor A
